build_computesupport_for_bmg_node: build a ComputeSupport instance to compute all possible tensor values for a BMG graph node
create_support_for_bernoulli_node: create a ComputeSupport typer to compute the two-value support set for a Bernoulli distribution node
create_support_for_categorical_node: create a ComputeSupport typer to compute the discrete index support set for a Categorical distribution node
compute_support_for_switch_node: compute the union of possible tensor values across all branches of a SwitchNode in the BMG graph
review_always_infinite_node_types: review the set of BMG node types that always have infinite support such as NormalNode and GammaNode
